hero.headline: Global Trust, Local Excellence
hero.subheadline: Our facility is designed to meet and exceed the world's most rigorous data security and operational compliance standards.

sections.title: Meeting the Standards of Global Enterprise
sections.body: For an infrastructure project in Kenya to serve global AI clients, compliance is not optional. Kenya AI Compute is committed to a multi-year roadmap for international certifications. Our facility is designed following ISO 27001 (Information Security) and SOC 2 Type II principles from the ground up. We ensure that our operational procedures, physical access controls, and network management meet the standards expected by Fortune 500 companies and leading research institutions. Furthermore, we align with international environmental standards (ISO 14001) to validate our green energy and PUE claims. This commitment ensures that moving your compute to Kenya does not mean compromising on the corporate compliance required by your auditors and stakeholders. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confide

sections.title: Compliance Roadmap
items: ISO 27001: Implementing the world's leading standard for info-security management.
SOC 2 Type II: Regular auditing of our security, availability, and privacy controls.
GDPR Alignment: Adhering to the highest global standard for data protection.
Uptime Institute: Pursuing formal Tier II/III certification for Phase 2.
ISO 14001: Third-party verification of our sustainability and ESG metrics.
